{{Quote|These things are everywhere!|A [[501st Legion/Legends|501st]] [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] being attacked by acklays|<ref name="Star Wars: Battlefront II">''[[Star Wars: Battlefront II]]''</ref>}}
'''Acklays''' {{Pronounced|Ăk'-lā}}<ref name="The New Essential Guide to Alien Species" /> were [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]] carnivores native to [[Vendaxa/Legends|Vendaxa]]. Acklays had sharp claws and thick skin, and averaged 3.05 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall. Due to these attributes, as well as the [[Species/Legends|species]]' ferocity, acklays were often exported from Vendaxa to be used in [[Gladiator/Legends|gladiatorial]] combat. The creatures could be found on [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]],<ref name="The New Essential Guide to Alien Species" /> where they were commonly brought in to fight other creatures&mdash;and sentients&mdash;in the [[Petranaki arena]]. An acklay was used in the attempted execution of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], but was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by Kenobi. In addition to Geonosis, the creatures could be also found on [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] such as [[Lehon/Legends|Lehon]]<ref name="atl" /> and [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]].<ref name="Star Wars: Battlefront II" />

==Biology and appearance==
The [[Insect/Legends|insect]]-like<ref name="Star Wars: Attack of the Clones Cine-Manga">[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones Cine-Manga|''Star Wars: Attack of the Clones'' Cine-Manga]]</ref> acklay was a three-eyed,<ref name="Star Wars: Legacy 5">[[Legacy (2006) 5|''Legacy'' (2006) 5]]</ref> amphibious, [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]], crustacean native to [[Vendaxa/Legends|Vendaxa]]. Though acklays lived [[Water/Legends|underwater]],<ref name="The New Essential Guide to Alien Species" /> these nightmarish predators<ref>{{SWMiniCite|set=Universe|pack=Acklay}}</ref> could go on land to hunt, which they frequently did, as the [[Lemnai/Legends|lemnai]], a creature that lived on the plains of Vendaxa, was their main source of food. As they resided in the [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]] of Vendaxa, their [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] enabled them to see in darkness, although they were near-sighted. Despite their crustacean-like nature, acklays also had characteristics possessed by reptiles, such as their powerful jaws filled with sharp teeth. The acklay had a tough, leathery skin that ranged in [[Color/Legends|color]] from green to brown, another trait from its reptilian heritage. Its belly was more vulnerable than other parts of its body, as the flesh covering it was not as tough as it was elsewhere. Acklays had a bony crest around their neck, used for both intimidation and protection.<ref name="The New Essential Guide to Alien Species" />

[[File:Acklay_SWG.jpg|thumb|left|250x250px|A mutant acklay escaped from the Geonosian Bio-Lab on Yavin 4.]]

These creatures had small stomachs, but were capable of expanding them when necessary. They had a high metabolism, which gave them substantial amounts of energy, but also caused them to starve quickly. Acklays were aggressive creatures, making them favorites in [[Gladiator/Legends|gladiatorial]] combat.<ref name="The New Essential Guide to Alien Species" />

Each acklay had six deadly claws, used for both pinning an opponent in combat or slicing them. Their limbs were long, allowing them to strike at enemies from a distance. While their claws&mdash;actually fingertips covered by hardened skin&mdash;themselves had no feeling, hairs on their bodies allowed the creatures the sensation of feeling.<ref name="Acklay in the Databank">{{DB|creature|acklay|acklay}}</ref> These cilia also enabled an acklay to sense the neuro-electric energy of other life-forms. The acklay's exoskeleton was strong enough to be used by some cultures as chitinous personal body [[Armor/Legends|armor]]. Although not high tech, it was occasionally used as a trophy item.<ref name="The New Essential Guide to Alien Species" />

Like some reptilian species, acklays had a bony neck plate that they displayed to intimidate opponents. This also protected the acklay from overhead neck attacks. In addition, acklays could use this plate as a type of weapon, by bucking and weaving their heads to and fro to strike an opponent.<ref name="The New Essential Guide to Alien Species" />

Acklays could be [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]], although this was an extremely rare mutation. Such creatures could teach themselves to use [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] and could fire [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]] from their mouths.<ref name="Memories">{{LivingForce|Looking In: Memories}}</ref>

==History==
[[File:Acklay_Vendaxa.jpg|thumb|200px|An acklay attacking Cade Skywalker and his companions on Vendaxa]]
Acklays were native to Vendaxa, where they were one of the main predators. However, acklays were transported to other [[Planet/Legends|planets]], most notably the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] world of [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]], where they were a common fixture in gladiator arenas.<ref name="The New Essential Guide to Alien Species" />

During the [[Second Imperial Civil War]], a type of aquatic vehicle called the [[Acklay-class mobile fortress|Acklay Battle Fortress]] was used by [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire]].<ref name="Legacy 32">[[Legacy (2006) 32|''Legacy'' (2006) 32]]</ref> In [[137 ABY]], [[Cade Skywalker]] and his companions encountered an acklay on Vendaxa, following [[Marasiah Fel]]'s escape from [[Socorro/Legends|Socorro]]. The acklay pursued its prey through a crash site, but was ultimately [[Death/Legends|killed]] when Jedi [[Wolf Sazen]] and [[Shado Vao]] joined the fight, plunging their lightsabers through the acklay's chest.<ref name="Star Wars: Legacy 5" />

==Acklays in the galaxy==
{{Quote|Acklay! Don't provoke it!|Anonymous [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] clone trooper|<ref name="Star Wars: Battlefront II" />}}
Acklays were prized by collectors of brutal exotica.<ref name="Starships & Vehicles Collection 1">[[Star Wars: The Official Starships & Vehicles Collection 1|''Star Wars: The Official Starships & Vehicles Collection'' 1]], [[Star Wars A–Z]] section.</ref> The [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosians]]&mdash;who traded [[Droid/Legends|droids]] and machinery for acklays&mdash;also took to breeding them, and the acklays soon found their way into the ecosystem of the barren planet, quickly carving out a niche for themselves. In some instances, acklays even destroyed entire hives by sneaking in through the lower tunnels and feasting on worker drones. The acklay also became the dominant predator of the stagnant [[Ebon Sea]] area, as it had only one predator on Geonosis: the [[Merdeth/Legends|merdeth]].<ref name="The New Essential Guide to Alien Species" /> Due to chemical contamination in the water, a population of amphibious [[mutant acklay]]s developed in [[Golbah's Pit]]. They had glossy black skin and were larger, stronger and more heavily armored than their cousins. They could also breathe underwater when they hunted in the Ebon Sea.<ref name="Geonosis">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref> [[File:Acklay3.jpg|thumb|250px|An acklay in the [[Petranaki arena]]|left]]
Several of the creatures were brought to fight in the Geonosian arenas,<ref name="Starships & Vehicles Collection 1" /> with two acklays being held in the [[Petranaki arena]] and used in gladiator matches.<ref name="CL">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> The Geonosian gladiator [[Acklay Chopper]] became fight manager of the arena after he fought and killed an acklay in it.<ref name="Geonosis" /> Prior to the onset of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Unidentified acklay (Petranaki Arena)/Legends|one of the acklays]],<ref name="Star Wars Episode II: Attack of the Clones" /> a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]]-sized one,<ref name=":1">[[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones (junior novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'' junior novelization]]</ref> was unleashed upon [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], who had been convicted of espionage and sentenced for execution. [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]], who was observing the scene,<ref name="Star Wars Episode II: Attack of the Clones" /> reconized the beast from books he read.<ref name=":0">''[[Boba Fett: The Fight to Survive]]''</ref> The acklay attempted to kill Kenobi, though the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] was able to free himself by timing the creature's attack so its claws broke the chain holding him to a pillar. After a [[Jedi assault team/Legends|Jedi task force]] intervened to rescue the trio,<ref name="Star Wars Episode II: Attack of the Clones" /> the acklay roamed the arena floor in a frenzy. It still stalked Kenobi, who was finally able to silence its terrifying howls<ref name="SWE-acklay">{{SWE|characters|acklay|acklay}}</ref> with skillful swipes of an newly obtained [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], finally killing the beast.<ref name="Star Wars Episode II: Attack of the Clones">{{Film|II}}</ref> After the battle Boba passed by the dead acklay, still left in the arena, while searching for his father.<ref name=":0" /> Meanwhile the fallen acklay's mate survived in their holding pen.<ref name="CL" />

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], an acklay on [[Burnout (space station)|Burnout]], a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] in the [[Thaereian system]], made appearances in an arena there, where prisoners of the [[Thaereian military]] would be fed to it, while spectators watched from viewscreens. The [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Nim'Ri]] was one such prisoner, and he was given a [[Vibro-ax/Legends|vibro-axe]] to fight the creature with. However, it pushed the axe out of his hands and killed him, much to the delight of the crowd.<ref name="TAUT">{{LivingForce|Looking In: The Air Up Thaere}}</ref> A short time later, a group of prisoners from the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]] were put in the arena with it. However, several agents working for the [[Cularin Militia]] entered the arena and fought the creature, while rescuing the prisoners.<ref name="Memories" /> The slaver [[Phylus Mon]], who favored huge, monstrous beasts, dealt with acklays as well.<ref name="A Mon Alone">{{LivingForce|A Mon Alone}}</ref>

Acklays were also exported to the world of [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]]. During the Clone Wars, the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] encountered acklays trying to destroy an [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer/Legends|All Terrain Tactical Enforcer]] during the [[Battle of Felucia (Outer Rim Sieges)/Legends|Battle of Felucia]].<ref name="Star Wars: Battlefront II" /> The [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] were initially overcome by the creatures, but were able to kill all of them.<ref name="The New Essential Guide to Alien Species" /> During the rule of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], a number of acklays were owned by [[Molpol's Traveling Circus]].<ref name="Millennium Falcon">[[Millennium Falcon (novel)|''Millennium Falcon'']]</ref> Around this time, a ride called the [[Geonosis Arena Acklay-Rider]] was in operation at [[Aucellis Park]], an entertainment center located on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Keriba VI]].<ref name="Beneath Aucellis Park">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20030821aucellis|text=Beneath Aucellis Park|int=Beneath Aucellis Park}}</ref> At least one acklay was believed to be present in the rumored [[Geonosian Bio-Lab]] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]].<ref name="Galaxies">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref> The [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Borvo]] also kept [[Borvo's acklay|one]] in the dungeon beneath his [[Borvo's Vault|hidden base]] near [[Moenia/Legends|Moenia]], on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].<ref name="SWG:ORDMBBD">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Old Republic Droid Modules: Borvo's Battle Droid|Naboo}}</ref> An engineered acklay was kept inside a secret [[Illegal Lab (Corellia)|laboratory]] that was operated by [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Maldien]] on the planet [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. However, around [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], the creature escaped and killed [[Jenson]], the facility's lead creature handler.<ref name="SWG:CMCOtZ">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Coronet Murmurs: Clear Out the Zoo|Corellia}}</ref> The Imperial officer [[Ozzik Sturn]], who enjoyed hunting, kept an acklay head as a trophy by [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]].<ref name="TFU">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed]]''</ref> Acklays could also be found on the planet [[Lehon/Legends|Lehon]], located in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]].<ref name="atl">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|I pictured the acklay as the embodiment of chaos.|[[Robert E. Barnes]]|<ref name="art">''[[The Art of Star Wars Episode II: Attack of the Clones]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Acklay_concept_art.jpg|thumb|250x250px|Concept art of an acklay]]
The acklay first appeared in the [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones (novelization)|novelization]] of [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']], which was released a month prior to the film's theatrical debut.<ref name="Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones novelization">[[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'' novelization]]</ref> The design of the acklay originated when [[George Lucas]] requested the creation of an arena creature sharing the characteristics of [[Wikipedia:Praying mantis|praying mantises]] and [[Wikipedia:Velociraptor|Velociraptors]]. Later refinements added [[Wikipedia:Lobster|lobster]] features to the creature.<ref name="Acklay in the Databank" /> Designers also used dried fruits and vegetables to create the texture of the acklay's skin.<ref name="art" /> The acklay's fight with Obi-Wan Kenobi was inspired in part by the [[Wikipedia:Ray Harryhausen|Ray Harryhausen]] movie ''Mysterious Island'', particularly the scene where a marooned sailor fights a giant crab with a spear.<ref name="Acklay in the Databank" /> The acklay's sound was created from the sounds of a dolphin and a pig.<ref name="Drawing from the Present: Familiar Creatures in a Galaxy Far, Far Away">{{SW|url=news/drawing-from-the-present-familiar-creatures-in-a-galaxy-far-far-away|text=Drawing from the Present: Familiar Creatures in a Galaxy Far, Far Away|int=Back from the Drawing Board|nolive=1}}</ref> Dried melons were used as a texture plate, in order to find a color scheme.<ref name="art" />

In the [[Mighty Chronicles]] [[Attack of the Clones (Mighty Chronicles)|adaptation]] of ''Attack of the Clones'' the acklay is killed by Obi-Wan early in the arena execution, after hurling at the acklay and piercing its abdomen with the [[Picador/Legends|picador]] [[Spear/Legends|spear]].<ref name="Attack of the Clones Mighty Chronicles">[[Attack of the Clones (Mighty Chronicles)|''Attack of the Clones'' Mighty Chronicles adaptation]]</ref> In the [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones (junior novelization)|junior novelization]] the acklay is implied to have died after being pierced in the neck with the spear.<ref name=":1" />
